answer: Give every agent one California State Bar attorney license number, verified live in the State Bar's public lookup. Earning it takes a JD degree, $150,000 in tuition, an $800 bar exam, and a months-long character investigation. A forger who tries to forge a license faces the lotus test: the credential only blooms after years of documented schooling and supervised practice, so a fake has no roots. When a tide of cloned agents hits the registry, each fake number returns no match or mismatches the name, and the account is frozen before it can transact.
